# v2.35-dev Release Notes

## Performance: the Currently Expired report now scales to any size

The next phase of the performance work. The **Currently Expired** report used to
pull the *entire* training-records dataset into your browser, crunch the charts
and totals there, and draw **every** matching row at once. On a large database
that meant a big download and a sluggish page. This release moves that work to
the server and paginates the table, so the page stays fast no matter how many
records have lapsed.

### What changed

- **Server-side computation.** The two charts, the four KPI cards, and the group
  subtotals are now calculated on the server (and cached), so your browser
  downloads a small summary instead of the whole history.
- **Paginated detail table.** The list of expired records now pages — use the
  controls beneath the table to move through results and change the page size.
  Only one page of rows is loaded and rendered at a time.
- **Everything else is unchanged.** The same charts, the same numbers, the same
  filters (search, type, theatre, lapse-band, group-by, exclude-retired), and the
  same click-a-band-to-filter behaviour. **Exports still contain the full filtered
  set**, not just the visible page — CSV/Excel/PDF are unaffected.

### Notes

- No database migration and no configuration required.
- The report's numbers were verified to match the previous version exactly across
  filter, sort and grouping combinations — only *how* the data is fetched and
  displayed changed.
- Grouped view: group headers now show each group's full total and page through
  with the rest of the table.

### Coming next

Further phases will give the same server-aggregation + pagination treatment to
the other large report pages (Learner Achievement Scorecard, Comparison) and to
the Students list.
